content.text:
**Analyzing Grid Transformation**

I'm processing the input grid, noting a red hollow rectangle from rows 2-8 and columns 3-9, containing a single red pixel at (5, 6). My current focus is on understanding why the interior zeros within this shape are transforming to yellow (4).
